name: Jumper
description: Jumper is a cross-chain swap and bridge aggregator powered by LI.FI. It compares bridges and DEXs to move and swap assets between EVM chains, Solana, Bitcoin and Sui in a single flow.
description_zh: Jumper 是由 LI.FI 驱动的跨链兑换和跨链桥聚合器。它比较各个跨链桥和 DEX，在一个流程中完成 EVM 链、Solana、比特币和 Sui 之间的资产转移与兑换。

geo_site.method: Cloudflare refuses the whole site (and api.jumper.xyz) with its block page, without geo wording; the countries are those of the live probe (see the observations; 2026-10-12: CU, IR, SY, the only ones of 62 refused, so a country rule).

geo_feature.scope: RWA-based Jumper Earn opportunities (the pages under /earn/<campaign>): the app asks api.jumper.xyz/v1/geo-gates which gates apply to the visitor's country (Cloudflare geolocation) and replaces the gated pages with 'Access unavailable in your region'. The country list is the gates' own Countries field (2026-10-12); the live probe confirms the gate from 13 of 62 countries, the other three are refused by Cloudflare before the API answers.

screening.provider: LI.FI API (li.quest): /v1/quote for an SDN address -> HTTP 422

tos.restricted: BY, CI, Crimea, CU, DPR, IR, IQ, Kherson, LR, LY, LPR, MM, KP, RU, SD, SY, VE, Zaporizhzhia

notes: Frontend code is clean; routes come from the LI.FI API, which screens addresses (LI.FI's ToS also excludes US persons). URL note: jumper.exchange -> 302.
live: LI.FI /v1/quote: SDN fromAddress -> 422, control -> quote OK

api_probes.name: geo-gates
api_probes.note: The app asks which geo gates apply to the visitor's country (Cloudflare geolocation); a gate with Outcome=block replaces the pages under its PathPrefix (RWA Earn opportunities).

rules.note: a geo gate applies: the Earn pages under its PathPrefix show 'Access unavailable in your region'
